drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel:
Dear Counsel,

In response to your request for specificity, we have supplemented our objections section to identify categories of requests we consider overly broad or unduly burdensome, such as those seeking voluminous data outside the relevant time frame or unrelated to the subject matter of the litigation. We have also provided a detailed privilege log consistent with applicable rules, attached herewith, identifying all documents withheld on protected grounds. We remain committed to good faith cooperation and timely discovery and reserve all rights to supplement or clarify our responses as necessary.

Best regards,

Aldous Finch LLP

edits.text: 1. GENERAL OBJECTIONS. Defendant objects to each request to the extent it seeks privileged material, is overly broad, unduly burdensome, or not reasonably calculated to lead to the discovery of admissible evidence. Specifically, Defendant objects to requests seeking voluminous documents outside the relevant time frame, data unrelated to the claims or defenses at issue, and requests that would impose disproportionate burden relative to their likely benefit.
edits.name: Enhance General Objections for specificity

edits.text: 3. PRIVILEGE LOG. Documents withheld on privilege or other protected grounds are identified in the attached privilege log, which has been prepared in accordance with applicable rules to enable Plaintiff's assessment of the basis for withholding.
